name: Extrudr (FD3D GmbH)
summary: Austrian filament manufacturer based in Lauterach, Vorarlberg, trading as Extrudr under the legal entity FD3D GmbH. Produces in Austria with in-house laser-micrometer diameter QC, and is best known for GreenTEC and GreenTEC Pro - oil-free, bio-based engineering materials positioned as sustainable alternatives to petrochemical polymers.

product_lines.name: PLA
product_lines.notes: Includes the NX2 specialty PLA line

product_lines.name: GreenTEC / GreenTEC Pro
product_lines.notes: Bio-based, oil-free engineering material; a proprietary biopolymer blend with no established filament type id

product_lines.name: BioFusion
product_lines.notes: Bio-based composite line; base polymer not confirmed

additional_notes: No evidence of white-labelling for others or of reselling, so no oem_relationships are recorded; Extrudr does not appear in research/verified-oem-relationships.md. Pricing roughly $24-38/kg per a third-party review aggregator, comparable to Fillamentum and colorFabb. Whether Extrudr sells build plates was not established - the site has an accessories section but no build-plate product was found - so makes_plates is left unset. Some third-party reviews report batch-to-batch diameter variability despite the company's QC claims. Whether all raw polymer feedstock is EU-sourced versus imported resin is unverified; manufacturing_countries reflects extrusion location.

provenance.conflicts: Company QC claims (laser micrometer, tight tolerance) versus third-party reports of batch-to-batch diameter variability are unreconciled. GreenTEC and BioFusion have no mapped filament type ids.
